sections.description: AmStore is a WordPress online store theme developed by WpDevArt. This is a modern and powerful store theme that is fully responsive and integrated with the WooCommerce plugin. With this theme, you can easily create any online store you need, from an electronics store or a grocery store to a wholesale store. It is a multipurpose theme so you can use it for any type of website or blog other than online stores. There are many features and options related to the homepage, blog, pages, and posts. The Custom Homepage of the AmStore theme comes with various pre-built sections, allowing you to showcase different types of information on your homepage, from banners to sales. There are eleven sections available for the homepage, and some of these sections are also available for the store page and are pre-built as patterns. Three of these sections are available in the free version, while the premium version comes with all these sections. Here is a list of the sections: Banner, WooCommerce, Call to Action, Achievements, Advantages, Services, Sales, Benefits of Ordering, Shop by Brand, Shop by Category, and Latest posts. WordPress online store theme has many benefits. First of all, the theme is well-structured and optimized. This means that the code is clear and does not load unnecessary scripts or files. This is an SEO-ready theme and works great with popular SEO plugins. Another big benefit is the breadcrumbs. You don't need to add any additional plugins to add breadcrumbs to your site, AmStore offers this option. By the way, you can add breadcrumbs for both simple pages/posts and store pages. AmStore comes with different layouts available for different pages. You can add/remove sidebar separately from posts, pages, blog, search page, shop page, or product pages. Additionally, the theme has three global sizes available: normal, wide, and full-width (this option is only available in the premium version). There are many features and options that deserve our attention, but it will be better if you install and try the theme in action to see all the benefits that AmStore has to offer.
